newsitem.title: USA: Catherines March same-store sales up.
newsitem.headline: Catherines March same-store sales up.

text.p: Catherines Stores Corp said Thursday that its unaudited comparable store sales for the five-week period ended April 5 increased one percent.
Comparable sales year to date decreased 1.3 percent, the company said.

The company said total sales increased 3.5 percent to $29.2 million from $28.2 million in the five-week March period. Total sales year to date increased 1.7 percent to $48.9 million from $48.0 million in 1996, the company said.

Easter Sunday fell into the March period, giving March one less sales day than last year, the company said. If March had been a comparable period, its comparable store sales would have increased 2.6 percent, the company said.
